name: Marriage And Divorce
overview: Scripture presents marriage as a sacred union where a man and woman become one flesh, emphasizing the blessing and favor found in this covenant relationship (Genesis 2:24; Proverbs 18:22). While the Old Testament permits divorce under certain conditions, such as when uncleanness is found (Deuteronomy 24:1), the Lord expresses His hatred for the act of putting away a spouse, warning against treachery and violence in such dealings (Malachi 2:16). Jesus further clarifies that divorce should only occur on the grounds of fornication, as putting away a wife otherwise leads to adultery, underscoring the seriousness and sanctity of the marriage bond (Matthew 5:31-32).
